title: Aromatic Sardinian Pork Tagliatelle
description: A salty and snappy Sardinian dish featuring slow-cooked pork and egg rolls, perfect for a date night, with a focus on ayurvedic tamasic friendly ingredients. This dish combines the rich flavors of Italy with the warmth of a slow-cooked meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the garlic, onion, carrots, and celery and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the pork shoulder and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the tomato paste, red wine, and beef broth, and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer to the preheated oven.
Braise the pork for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender.
While the pork is cooking, prepare the egg roll wrappers according to package instructions.
After the pork has finished cooking, shred it with two forks and stir in any accumulated juices.
Cook the tagliatelle according to package instructions and serve with the shredded pork and egg rolls.
